description: Commission of Elections -  Elected members of the  Maharagama Urban Council, (B. D. S. Dharmapriya and other 14 names)
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in a local government council (Maharagama Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes including declarations of elected members to fill positions vacated by resignations, which falls under election-related matters. The content references specific electoral wards, nomination procedures, and the authority of election officials, making it clearly about electoral processes rather than general government personnel changes or other administrative matters.
